svg.title: Deploy order
svg.desc: Store and verify the CPonAWS key first, then deploy the core stack, whose targets check the key when they are created, then the Cedar policy stack, then run the smoke test. Without a key, deploy both stacks with enable1p=false.
svg.text: BAD KEY: TARGET FAILS, STACK ROLLS BACK
Claude has no fallback until step 1
WHY THE KEY LIVES OUTSIDE THE STACKS: a stack-owned secret would be deleted on rollback, and the rollback is exactly what a bad key causes.
